name: llama.cpp llama-server
native_tools: --jinja is required for tool calls. Add --chat-template-file <file.jinja> when the GGUF's built-in template has no tools section (crit doctor model warns when /props shows such a template).
kv_cache: f16 (default) or q8_0. Avoid q4_0: tool-call arguments and long code degrade. A quantized V cache needs flash attention (-fa; newer builds take -fa on|off|auto).
reasoning: --reasoning-format deepseek puts thinking in reasoning_content (the default in recent builds); crit reads both that and <think> blocks.
cache: crit sends cache_prompt and keeps one slot per conversation; keep -np (parallel slots) at or above the number of helper chats.

speculation.ngram: Prompt-lookup / n-gram speculation exists in some builds; the option names change between releases: check llama-server --help in your build.

notes: Flags are from llama.cpp builds of late 2025; run llama-server --help to confirm them for yours.
